availability.notes: The maintainer selected this archived build for compatibility testing. Apple's US lookups for app ID 356468446 and the exact com.deluxe.Pipes bundle identifier each returned zero results on 2026-07-18. This is a factual project-scope check, not a legal conclusion.

reports.summary: Loads Percy's main NIB and remains alive on Windows after resolving its archived navigation-bar classes, but does not display usable game content because the navigation-controller hierarchy is not restored.
milestones: Loaded the armv6 app and completed MainWindow NIB class resolution past the previously fatal UINavigationBar and UINavigationItem boundary.
Created a 480x320 window, initialized the audio session, requested the preferred language, and remained alive through a controlled 17-second observation.
Accepted a close request sent only to the spawned tapHLE window and exited without a Rust panic or forced termination.
reports.blocker: UINavigationController does not restore the archived view-controller stack and parent-child relationships, so it falls back to an empty plain UIView and no guest EAGL frame is submitted.
reports.notes: The full Archive.org metadata, content hashes, embedded identity, and tapHLE --info verification passed immediately before the clean exact-commit release run. The binary identified itself as 1ae13a34 and used bundled default options in a fresh sandbox. A requested guest-frame capture produced no EAGL frame. A separate process-owned 480x320 desktop capture was black but is not standalone rendering evidence because desktop OpenGL capture can be unreliable; the blocker classification also relies on the logged empty UIView fallback and absence of any submitted guest frame.
